articles.summary: HireQuest Direct announces Brittney Benjamin as the new owner of its Roanoke, Virginia franchise. Benjamin's staffing and sales experience positions her to connect local businesses with qualified workers.
articles.title: HireQuest Direct Welcomes Brittney Benjamin as New Owner of Roanoke, Virginia, Location

articles.summary: Retailers are taking a targeted approach to seasonal hiring as holiday sales are projected to surpass $1 trillion. Learn how brands are staffing stores, warehouses, and fulfillment operations for peak demand.
articles.title: Retailers take a targeted approach to seasonal hiring in preparation for historic holiday sales year
